---
### DATABASE EXPORTS (Manual)

This folder is the destination for all database dumps generated by the user.

---
### USAGE

When you run:

```make dump-database db=<your_db_name>```

The system will generate a timestamped, gzipped SQL file here.

Example: ```dbname_dump-2025-12-29_11-45-00.sql.gz```

> [!NOTE]
> 
> Files here are stored on your host machine for safety. They are not
> synced into the database unless you move them to `imports` folder and run the
> import command.
